goal: Turn the previously observed wetland method-induced prevalence sign reversals into explicit source-positive-only partial-identification intervals for a hypothetical static binary site-species status, without treating non-detection as biological absence.

original_source.study: Wenner et al. (2025), Global Ecology and Conservation 62 e03837, source data Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.15044115 CC BY 4.0
original_source.original_Q1: 27 sites, 13 intervention, 6 control, 8 artificial; nine species; 243 possible site-species binary statuses

logical_assumptions.perfect_specificity_conditional: Assume every source-recorded positive biological count indicates a genuinely positive site-species state; this assumption itself is not externally verified.
logical_assumptions.static_binary_site_status: Hypothetical fixed site×species status over the source survey, solely to calculate set-theoretic identified bounds; not a claim of real biological closure over up to 91 days.
logical_assumptions.nondetection_uninformative: Every original native site×species without a positive source record can be either present or absent; no validated negatives or detection probabilities.
logical_assumptions.no_additional_world_constraints: No spatial interactions, ecological dynamics, richness constraints, phylogeny, joint occupancy dependence, prior odds, or A/B/M movement/viability restriction is imposed.

fixed_design.source_cohort: exact original paper Q1 27 site IDs and categories; do not delete or duplicate source rows
fixed_design.method_panels: all 15 nonempty subsets of acoustic, visual, dipnet, bottletrap (same fixed enumeration as method_channel_lattice_v1)
fixed_design.sign_contrasts: 9 source species × 3 pairs: intervention-control, intervention-artificial, artificial-control
fixed_design.record_definition: positive within a selected method panel if any original CSV count>0 for that site×species on a method included in that panel

categorical_bounds.for_group: pi_g in [k_g / n_g, 1], conditional on zero false-positive recorded occurrences
categorical_bounds.for_contrast: Delta_(A-B) in [k_A/n_A - 1, 1 - k_B/n_B], attainable extremes for independent unconstrained static site-status assignments
categorical_bounds.classify: two_sided_strict_signs_possible | nonnegative_only | nonpositive_only | exact_zero; zero is always feasible

preregistered_endpoints: all 15 method panels × 27 recorded taxon/category comparisons: observed positive-rate difference, exact conditional lower/upper possible true-rate difference, status class, attainable negative/zero/positive sign flags
for all five original full-vs-AV observed-strict-sign-reversal cases, display both full and AV conditional interval, verified containment and observed-sign versus latent-sign nonidentification
number of full versus AV contrasts that are two-sided, weakly one-sided, or exactly zero, with no strict ecological sign identification

site×species binary mask bookkeeping: 27×9=243 possible statuses, full positives 144, AV positives 104; free/unfixed count and 2^free unconstrained assignments, NOT actual EOG ecological worlds or probability/entropy claims
for all nested method panels P⊆Q, positive witness O_P⊆O_Q and conditional contrast interval I_Q ⊆ I_P, checked for all original 27 contrasts

full source positive constraints always supersede any restricted method panel (assuming perfect positive specificity): return full-source intervals as authoritative conditional bounds even if method-restricted observed rate reverses
record exact whole-panel source-positive site-species denominators and categories; SHA-stamped result/CSV source receipts
hard_stop: No true occupancy estimates, occupancy probabilities, verified absences, detection model, p-values, confidence intervals, independent ecological replicates, original R-unmarked coefficient refit, or causal treatment effect

2^free is a count of unconstrained Boolean static site×species completions, NOT counts of EOG finite transition worlds, not evidence of process identifiability, and not information entropy in a probabilistic sense
With no verified absences and all-present completion compatible, a strictly positive or strictly negative category-rate difference cannot be identified using source positives alone
Results conditional on recorded positives being correct; no assumption that the survey species status is closed over up to 91 days is verified
No model attribution to A, B or M, additional scored EOG-WF endpoint or merge of Draft PR #697
